mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(c.id) AS id, c.title, c.description, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, c.deleted_at AS deletedAt, c.release_date AS releaseDate, c.origin_country AS originCountry, s.sport_type AS sportType, s.league, s.season, s.home_team AS homeTeam, s.away_team AS awayTeam, s.venue, s.status, s.kickoff_at AS kickoffAt FROM contents c LEFT JOIN content_sports s ON s.content_id = c.id WHERE c.source = 'SPORTS_DB' AND c.type = 'SPORT' AND c.source_id = #{sourceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) FROM contents WHERE source = 'SPORTS_DB' AND type = 'SPORT' AND source_id = #{sourceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT t.name, ct.source FROM content_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.content_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}) ORDER BY t.name

SELECT c.source_id FROM contents c JOIN content_sports s ON s.content_id = c.id WHERE c.source = 'SPORTS_DB' AND c.type = 'SPORT' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.source_id IS NOT NULL AND s.status <> 'CANCELED' AND ( (s.kickoff_at >= #{windowStart} AND s.kickoff_at < #{windowEnd}) OR s.status = 'POSTPONED' OR ( s.status <> 'FINISHED' AND TIMESTAMPADD( MINUTE, CASE WHEN LOWER(s.sport_type) LIKE '%soccer%' OR LOWER(s.sport_type) LIKE '%football%' THEN #{soccerDurationMinutes} WHEN LOWER(s.sport_type) LIKE '%basketball%' THEN #{basketballDurationMinutes} WHEN LOWER(s.sport_type) LIKE '%baseball%' THEN #{baseballDurationMinutes} ELSE #{defaultDurationMinutes} END, s.kickoff_at ) > #{now} ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contents ( id, type, title, description, thumbnail_url, source, source_id, release_date, origin_country, average_rating, review_count, rating_sum, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), 'SPORT', #{title}, #{description}, #{thumbnailUrl}, 'SPORTS_DB', #{sourceId}, #{releaseDate}, #{originCountry}, 0.0, 0, 0.00, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = incoming.title, description = incoming.description, thumbnail_url = incoming.thumbnail_url, release_date = incoming.release_date, origin_country = incoming.origin_country, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO content_sports ( content_id, sport_type, league, season, home_team, away_team, venue, status, kickoff_at ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}), #{sports.sportType}, #{sports.league}, #{sports.season}, #{sports.homeTeam}, #{sports.awayTeam}, #{sports.venue}, #{sports.status}, #{sports.kickoffAt} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sport_type = incoming.sport_type, league = incoming.league, season = incoming.season, home_team = incoming.home_team, away_team = incoming.away_team, venue = incoming.venue, status = incoming.status, kickoff_at = incoming.kickoff_at

INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (id, name, kind, created_at) VALUES
(UUID_TO_BIN(#{tag.id}), #{tag.name}, #{tag.kind}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT IGNORE INTO content_tags (tag_id, content_id, source) SELECT id, UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}), 'OPENAPI' FROM tags WHERE name IN
#{tag.name}
